dedupe_keys.name: drone orthoimage and building footprints of nejapa el salvador

description: This dataset gives a high-resolution drone orthoimage of the town of Nejapa, El Salvador, with a shapefile of digitised building footprints. It was deposited on Zenodo on 15 October 2025 by Joaquín Martín López and Yolanda Torres Fernández of the Universidad Politécnica de Madrid, within a university research project published in Applied Sciences as 'Bridging the Seismic Vulnerability Data Gap through UAV and 360º Imagery: The Case of Nejapa, El Salvador' (Torres et al., 2025). The orthoimage is a TIFF with approximate spatial accuracy of 20 cm; footprints were digitised using the latest population census layer as a reference. Coverage is the town of Nejapa. Access: one 381 MB zip on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the census reference layer is described as not updated, and building attributes beyond the footprint are not listed in the record. Simulation uses: building exposure inventories for seismic vulnerability assessment in Central American towns. Related records: the Malawi seismic scenario case study and OpenBuildingMap.
